output.review_comment: The PR contains inverted advantage logic for scores > 5 points that contradicts normal behavior without justification. The condition `if max(p1, p2) > 5: return "Advantage Player 2" if p1 > p2 else "Advantage Player 1"` reverses the expected mapping (p1 > p2 should give Player 1 advantage, not Player 2). While this may pass tests, the implementation appears to be test-specific logic rather than correct spec-based behavior. Verify with the team: (1) Is the inverted advantage logic really required by the spec? (2) If so, add explanation for why this non-intuitive behavior exists. If not, implement the straightforward logic without inversion.
